{{nihongo|'''Habuhime-no-Mikoto Shrine'''|波布比咩命神社}} is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|abstract|Q845945|ar|جينجا|arz|ضريح شنتو|bcl|Shinto shrine|ca|Jinja|cs|Šintoistická svatyně|da|Shinto-tempel|de|Shintō-Schrein|el|Σιντοϊστικό Ιερό|eo|Ŝintoa sanktejo|es|Jinja|eu|Jinja|fa|معبد شینتویی|fi|Šintolainen pyhäkkö|fr|Sanctuaire shinto|hi|शिंतो मंदिर|hr|Šintoistički hram|hu|Sintó szentély|id|Jinja|it|Jinja|ja|神社|ka|ძინძია|ko|신사 (신토)|lb|Shintō-Schräin|mr|शिंतो मंदिर|nl|Jinja (heiligdom)|no|Jinja|or|ଜିଞ୍ଜା|pl|Jinja|pt|Templo xintoísta|ru|Дзиндзя|sc|Jinja|simple|Shinto shrine|sl|Šintoistično svetišče|sr|Шинтоистички храм|sv|Jinja|th|ศาลเจ้าชินโต|tok|tomo sewi pi nasin sewi Sinto|tr|Şinto tapınağı|uk|Святилище (синто)|uz|Dzindzya|vi|Thần xã|wuu|神社|zh|神社|zh_yue|神社|qid=Q845945}} on {{ill|Ōshima, Tokyo|Q1204507|qid=Q1204507}} ({{ill|Izu Ōshima|Q1070580|qid=Q1070580}}), {{ill|Tokyo|Q1490|qid=Q1490}}. {{nihongo|'''Habuhime-no-Mikoto Shrine'''|波布比咩命神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Izu Province]].

It is identified as the {{ill|Shikinaisha|fr|Shikinaisha|zh|式內社|qid=Q134917286|lt=Shikinaisha}} "Habuhime-no-Mikoto Shrine"<ref name="geo">[https://izuoshima-geo.org/know/highlights/culturalsite/bunkasite-14.html Habuhime-no-Mikoto Shrine] - Izu Oshima Geopark</ref><ref name="navi">[https://oshima-navi.com/shrine/shrine002.html Habuhime-no-Mikoto Shrine] - Izu Oshima Navi</ref>.

== Enshrined deities ==
; Main deity
* Habuhime-no-Mikoto (????????) - one of the consorts of {{ill|Kotoshironushi-no-Mikoto|qid=Q8009611|lt=Kotoshironushi-no-Kami}} (Mishima Daimy?jin), also called Habu no ?kisaki. Her children are Ajiko-no-Mikoto (deity of {{ill|Omiya Shrine|Q131925939|qid=Q131925939|lt=?miya Shrine}}) and Haji-no-Mikoto (deity of {{ill|Hajikama Shrine|Q134930376|qid=Q134930376}}).

; Associated deities
